column1: # ShreeOS release performance targets, enforced by
# live image writes to its console.
# These are requirements, not measurements. No untouched-build baseline is
# committed yet, so Stage E deliberately fails until a baseline is reviewed and
# committed. The candidate must improve idle memory or CPU by 20%, unless the
# untouched image already meets both absolute limits.

column4: Plasma, KWin and the single configured dock must be ready before idle sampling

idle memory stretch target for the unified desktop image
sustained idle CPU, measured from /proc/stat over a 30 s window
a failed unit at idle is a defect, not a budget
